candidatePeople.note: In s0063 the source explicitly lists 趙王倫, meaning Lun, Prince of Zhao, between 東武公澹 and 太保何劭. The existing p054 record is Sima Lun 司馬倫, and its Chinese 趙王倫 mention in this unit already has title-reference kind. Both revised English fields render that same title-qualified reference as Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao. Bind the newly scanned shorter Sima Lun substring to this existing title-reference mention of p054, preserving its larger title-qualified interpretation rather than introducing an overlapping mention with a conflicting kind. This does not change Lun’s personal identity, create a person, or classify the bare name as an office.
